verdict.rationale: Bento gives an agent programmatic access through a hosted MCP server, a CLI covering the whole account, and a REST API. Audience data is clearly readable via subscriber search with tag, segment and date filters. Broadcast history can be reviewed through the API, but nothing shows read access to live workflow or sequence configuration and state, and nothing shows that campaign performance metrics are exposed. Missing for 10: API/MCP read access to live automations (workflows/sequences) and their status, campaign performance metrics (opens/clicks/revenue attribution) via API, hands-on corroboration of an agent producing a performance report.
